Classical Ayurvedic Heritage

Rooted in the Ideals of Charaka & Sushruta

Our treatment methodology is firmly anchored in the foundational samhitās of Ayurveda, treating the whole individual rather than merely suppressing symptoms.

“प्रयोजनं चास्य स्वस्थस्य स्वास्थ्यरक्षणमातुरस्य विकारप्रशमनं च॥”
“The supreme objective of Ayurveda is twofold: to preserve and protect the health of the healthy, and to eradicate disease and suffering in the afflicted.”
— Maharshi Charaka (Charaka Samhita, Sutrasthana 30.26)
⚖

Tridosha Harmony (సమదోష సమతుల్యత)

According to Sushruta, true health (Swastha) exists when Vata (movement), Pitta (metabolism), and Kapha (structure) are in dynamic equilibrium. We identify your natural constitution (Prakriti) and specific dosha vitiation (Vikriti) to craft your healing regimen.

🔥

Agni & Aama Detoxification (దీపన-పాచన)

Charaka identifies impaired digestive fire (Mandagni) as the root cause of systemic toxins (Aama). Through herbal Deepana-Pachana and Panchakarma, we cleanse the micro-channels (Srotas), restoring natural cellular nutrition and immunity.

🌿

Dincharya & Pathya Ahara (ఆహార నియమాలు)

*“Without proper diet, medicine is of no use; with proper diet, medicine is of no need.”* We provide individualized dietary (Pathya) and lifestyle (Dincharya / Ritucharya) counsel to ensure your recovery is permanent and self-sustaining.
